title: Horned Demon Sorcerer
description: A muscular demonic humanoid with dark fur, large curved horns, and a long white tail stands dynamically in combat. He holds a glowing blue magical orb in his raised right hand while casting a swirling red energy attack from his left, surrounded by floating embers, blue flames, and dark bats against a misty forest backdrop.
prompt: A powerful muscular demonic minotaur-like humanoid with black fur, large curved horns, long flowing black hair, and a long white fluffy tail, wearing ornate white and red robes with gold trim.
